title: Oops! All Restaurants!
content: So I just spent however long of my dream walking around a mall at the request of the owner, reminding all the restaurants and food-based shops to make sure their orders were in so they would be well-supplied by Monday... and the mall was 90% made up of those places. Most were food-court style with the counters right in the corridor, although a few were the type where you pick up off the shelves and buy at the register. Only two had internal seating areas but still have corridor facing counters you order at. Among the stores I remember: \- A fried pickle shop on the cross-section corner, with a bright yellow-green sign and walls. Friendly heavy-set owner with a NY/NJ accent. Acted like we knew each other. \- Mongolian BBQ type place next to the Pickle shop. (You pick your ingredients at the counter like Subway and they cook it on the flat top in front of you, at the end of the line.) Stern looking 50-ish Asian owner with a pencil mustache and a mole. \- Dimly-lit Deli-ish looking place on the opposite corner. (Recurring dream location for unknown reasons.) There's some kind of eat-in Chinese place behind it in it's recurring dream appearances, but I didn't go in there this time. \- The magenta-colored sweets store with giant bags of caramel corn and candies and neon signs over each selection. 30-ish female owner, a dark apron with white stripes as the uniform. \- Nondescript restaurant where I couldn't tell what they served and all the decor and uniforms were pure white. The employees all seemed either angry or sullen. I found the whole place unnerving and left quickly. \- Purple-decor place that seems more like a movie theater concession stand with candy and slushies and so forth. This place did have an inset seating area to the right of the counter. There were plenty more, but not as vividly remembered. I do vaguely recall a Greek gyro place, a hot dog place, and that the place on the other side of the Fried Pickles served popcorn chicken. **Have any of you ever had it where all the dream mall stores are the same types of places?** **And do any of the places I described sound familiar to you?**
